name: wisp-plugins
description: Wisp Plugins for Claude Code: a core plugin for risk-aware work, plus courier for shipping, muse for exploring and rendering options, mason for building plugins, and domain packs.

plugins.name: wisp
plugins.description: The core of Wisp Plugins. One work skill sizes each change by reversibility and blast radius, states outcome, constraints and evidence bar, picks the mode (explore, spike, fix, build, check, ship) and review depth, and sends shared or irreversible work to a fresh-context verifier.

plugins.name: mason
plugins.description: Build, audit, and behaviorally evaluate plugins in the v5 shape: few agents, one entry skill, must-hold rules as hooks. Design shared schemas and scaffold conformant agents. Skills: scaffold-plugin, audit-plugin, design-schema, scaffold-subagent, evaluate.

plugins.name: muse
plugins.description: Exploration and render plugin. Shows options before anything is decided: sketch builds and renders three structurally different options as an option-set@1 with a decision log, and promote carries a chosen option or a working spike into a requirement@1. Non-binding: no gate, spec or tests.

plugins.name: courier
plugins.description: Shipping plugin. Shepherds completed, verified code through commit, PR creation, review response, and changeset documentation. Skills: commit, pr, changeset, receive-feedback, post-review, release. Produces release-artifact@3 from changeset@3 inputs.

plugins.name: wisp-packs
plugins.description: House packs: plain markdown on how the owner builds (rust-house, ts-house), applied when a repo's AGENTS.md has a Packs: line or on /wisp-packs:load. Commands: load, list, suggest.
